info.title: Agent CI Hosted Runner API
info.description: Local hosted-runner stub (not a cloud product). Documents the paid-seat API sketch from docs/hosted-runner.md. OSS CLI remains free/offline; Bearer `demo` sketches paid seats. No `Authorization` is allowed unless `--require-key` (OSS local). `Authorization: Bearer demo` is allowed (paid-seat sketch). Any other Bearer token → 401 `{error}`. Local in-memory run queue (OSS): POST `/v1/runs` → **202** `{runId,status}` (`queued` or `running`); poll GET `/v1/runs/{id}` until `done`|`failed`|`error`. Optional POST body `failUnder` (number, typically 0–100): pass-rate `score` = passed/total×100 (0 if total=0). Completed run JSON always includes `score`. When `failUnder` is set, also `gate: {failUnder, passed}`. If `score < failUnder`, status is **`failed`** with `error: "below_threshold"` (JUnit `failures>=1`; synthetic `<failure message="below_threshold">` if all cases passed). Omit `failUnder` = no gate (status `done` as today). Queue full → **429** `{error:"queue_full"}` + `Retry-After`. In-memory finished-run history cap (OSS): `--runs-max` / env `RUNS_MAX` default **1000** completed (`done`|`failed`|`error`) runs. Over cap, drop oldest finished. Does **not** cap the in-flight queue (`--max-queue`). `0` = unlimited. `GET /v1/runs`, `GET /v1/runs/junit.xml`, `GET /v1/runs/tap.txt`, `GET /v1/runs/report.md`, `GET /v1/runs/report.html`, and `GET /v1/runs/annotations.txt` only see retained history; `GET /v1/runs/{id}` → **404** if dropped. Webhook already fired at complete. `GET /ready` is readiness: **200** `{ok:true, queue}` when POST `/v1/runs` would still enqueue (queued < maxQueue or a running slot is free); **503** `{ok:false, reason:"queue_full"}` + `Retry-After` when at capacity (queued+running such that POST would 429). On SIGTERM/SIGINT, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` wins (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining; new queue jobs are not started). Snapshot only — does not consume a queue slot. Liveness `GET /health` stays **200** always (includes the queue snapshot). Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`. Hosted autoscaling / multi-node pools = paid later. Optional `X-Request-Id` request header: echoed on **every** response (including 4xx / OPTIONS). If omitted or empty, the stub generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped). The same value is stored as `requestId` on POST `/v1/runs` records and returned by GET `/v1/runs/{id}` and list rows. Optional CORS: `--cors-origins` CSV or env `AGENT_CI_CORS_ORIGINS` (`*` allowed). Default omitted/empty = no extra CORS headers (deny). When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a listed Origin → 204 with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` / `Allow-Methods` / `Allow-Headers`; unlisted Origin → 403 `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`. Matching GET/POST include ACAO. Default allow/expose headers include `X-Request-Id`. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id` (browser JS can read 429/503 `Retry-After`). **429 rate limit**: `--rate-limit` / env `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` (alias `RATE_LIMIT_RPM`) default **120** requests/minute per client IP (`X-Forwarded-For` first hop, else socket). In-memory sliding window. Exceed → `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. `/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics` are **not** rate-limited (k8s probes / Prometheus). Distinct from queue-full 429 `{error:"queue_full"}`. Default 120 is generous so stack-demo / local-mvp queue curls never 429. 0 disables. `GET /openapi.json` serves this file. `GET /v1/runs/{id}/junit.xml` and `GET /v1/runs/junit.xml` return JUnit XML (`application/xml`) for one run or all completed runs (Actions/Jenkins/GitLab ingest; empty → tests="0"; XML escaped). `GET /v1/runs/{id}/tap.txt` (alias `/tap`) and `GET /v1/runs/tap.txt` return TAP version 13 (`text/plain; charset=utf-8`) for one run or all completed runs (empty → `1..0`; `#` in names escaped; gate fail → `not ok`). `GET /v1/runs/{id}/report.md` (alias `/md`) and `GET /v1/runs/report.md` return a Markdown run report (`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`) for GitHub Actions `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` / humans (empty aggregate → heading + no rows; `|` in names escaped; gate fail → `fail`). `GET /v1/runs/{id}/report.html` (alias `/html`) and `GET /v1/runs/report.html` return a self-contained HTML run report (`text/html; charset=utf-8`) for the local 5-min demo (empty aggregate → heading + “no runs”; names escaped; fail rows visually distinct; no CDN). `GET /v1/runs/{id}/annotations.txt` (alias `/annotations`) and `GET /v1/runs/annotations.txt` return GitHub Actions workflow commands (`text/plain; charset=utf-8`; fail → `::error title=<suite>/<case>::<message>`; gate fail → `::error title=gate::score N < failUnder M`; pass-only / empty → empty body, no `::error`). Does not require GitHub. `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against={otherId}` compares two **completed** runs (`done`|`failed`|`error`) by case identity `suite/name` → JSON `{ok,from,to,added,removed,regressed,fixed,unchanged}` (`regressed` = pass→fail, `fixed` = fail→pass; empty both → empty arrays and `unchanged` 0). Missing run → **404**. Incomplete (`queued`/`running`) → **409** `{error:"run_not_done"}`. CLI `diff --from a.json --to b.json` prints the same JSON. `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.md?against={otherId}` (alias `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against=&format=md`) returns the same comparison as Markdown (`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`) for GitHub Actions `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` (heading + counts + GFM tables for added/removed/regressed/fixed; `|` escaped; empty → heading + “no changes”). CLI `diff --from/--to --format md` prints the same Markdown (default `--format json`). Same 404/409/400 as JSON. JSON path unchanged. `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.html?against={otherId}` (alias `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against=&format=html`) returns the same comparison as self-contained HTML (`text/html; charset=utf-8`) for the local 5-min demo (heading + counts + tables for added/removed/regressed/fixed; names escaped; regressed rows red; empty → heading + “no changes”; no CDN). CLI `diff --from/--to --format html` prints the same HTML. Same 404/409/400 as JSON (error bodies stay JSON). Distinct from `--diff-baseline` (trajectory/score vs a saved snapshot). `GET /metrics` Prometheus text (gauges `agent_ci_queue_depth`, `agent_ci_running`; counters `agent_ci_runs_completed_total`, `agent_ci_runs_failed_total`; CORS matching GET includes ACAO, same as other GET). Optional run-complete webhook (OSS): `--webhook-url` or env `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_URL`. After a run reaches `done`|`failed`|`error`, fire-and-forget POST JSON `{runId,status,summary,requestId,conclusion}` plus `score` and `gate` when present (short timeout; webhook errors never fail the run). Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` (HMAC still signs the raw body only). Optional `--webhook-secret` or env `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_SECRET`: when set, POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 of the raw JSON body. On 5xx or network/timeout, OSS retries the POST once after ~50ms (success on first try = no retry; 4xx do not retry). Simple HMAC is OSS; exponential backoff / queues, key rotation, and timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. See `RunCompleteWebhook`. Optional `serve --watch`: poll `fixtures/` max mtime every ~400ms; `GET /v1/suites` still live-reads disk (picks up new dirs). On change, logs `regenerated` and bumps `GET /health` `watch.generation` (`WatchSnapshot`; omitted when `--watch` is off so stack-demo `/health` is unchanged). Main serve / stack-demo default off. **`GET /v1/config`** (redacted runtime config; public GET like `/v1/suites` — no Bearer): `{ok, queue:{max,queued,running}, failUnder, rateLimit:{perMinute}, cors:{origins}, runsMax, webhooks:{hasUrl,hasSecret}, suitesCount}`. **Never** webhook URL, webhook secret, Bearer tokens, or fixture file contents. CORS + `X-Request-Id`. See `getConfig` / `RuntimeConfig`. **`GET /v1/runs/{id}/cases`** (lightweight case inventory for CI dashboards: `{ok, runId, status, count, cases:[{suite, name, status, durationMs?}]}`; optional `?status=passed|failed|error|skipped`; unknown status → empty list **200**; cap **500** original suite order + `truncated:true`; empty / in-flight → **200** `cases:[]`; **never** prompts, expected/actual, output bodies, API keys, or webhook URLs). See `listRunCases` / `RunCases`. **`GET /v1/suites/{name}`** (suite detail; `name` is the suite id): `{ok, id, name, path, caseCount, cases:[{name}]}`. Cassette **names only** — **never** prompt, trajectory, expected/actual, or fixture file dumps. Empty suite → `cases:[]`. Unknown → **404** `{ok:false, error:suite_not_found}`. See `getSuite` / `SuiteDetail`.

get.summary: Liveness (always 200)

200.description: Stub is up (includes local queue snapshot)

get.description: Liveness. Always **200** `{ok:true, …, queue}` while the process is up, even when the in-memory queue is full (POST `/v1/runs` would 429). While draining SIGTERM/SIGINT, includes `shuttingDown: true` (omitted otherwise). Readiness is `GET /ready`. When `serve --watch` is on, includes `watch: { generation }` (`WatchSnapshot`); omitted otherwise. Not rate-limited.

get.summary: Readiness (503 when queue full or shutting down)
get.description: Readiness. **200** `{ok:true, queue}` when POST `/v1/runs` would still enqueue (a running slot is free, or `queued` < `maxQueue`). **503** `{ok:false, reason:"queue_full"}` + `Retry-After` when at capacity (queued+running such that POST would 429). On SIGTERM/SIGINT drain, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` wins over healthy 200. Snapshot only — does not consume a queue slot. Liveness remains `GET /health` (always 200; `shuttingDown: true` while draining). Compose/stack-demo healthchecks should stay on `/health`. Not rate-limited.

200.description: Ready: POST /v1/runs would enqueue. Includes local queue snapshot.

503.description: Not ready: in-memory queue is at capacity (`reason: queue_full`, `Retry-After` same as POST 429) **or** process is shutting down (`reason: shutting_down`) after SIGTERM/SIGINT. GET /health stays 200 (`shuttingDown: true` while draining).

get.summary: Prometheus metrics
get.description: Prometheus text exposition of the local in-memory run queue. Gauges: `agent_ci_queue_depth`, `agent_ci_running`. Counters: `agent_ci_runs_completed_total` (status=done), `agent_ci_runs_failed_total` (status=error). CORS: matching Origin GET includes ACAO (same as other GET). Unlisted Origin OPTIONS → **403** `cors_denied`. Not rate-limited.

200.description: Prometheus text exposition

text/plain.example:
# TYPE agent_ci_queue_depth gauge
agent_ci_queue_depth 0
# TYPE agent_ci_running gauge
agent_ci_running 0
# TYPE agent_ci_runs_completed_total counter
agent_ci_runs_completed_total 1
# TYPE agent_ci_runs_failed_total counter
agent_ci_runs_failed_total 0

get.summary: OpenAPI 3 document

200.description: OpenAPI JSON served from openapi/runner.openapi.json

get.summary: List recent runs
get.description: Retained in-memory runs (in-flight + finished history), newest `createdAt` first. History cap `--runs-max` / `RUNS_MAX` (default 1000 finished; `0` = unlimited; drop oldest `done`|`failed`|`error`; queue depth is separate). Exact path only — does not shadow GET `/v1/runs/{id}`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max runs to return (default 20, max 1000)

200.description: Run list

post.description: Enqueue suite path or embedded `cases`. Returns **202** `{runId,status}` (`queued` or `running`). Poll GET `/v1/runs/{id}`. Queue full → **429** `{error:"queue_full"}` + `Retry-After`. Sliding-window rate limit → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After` (see `RateLimited`; `/health` `/ready` `/metrics` skipped). Bad Bearer → **401**. Incoming `X-Request-Id` (or generated UUID) stored as `requestId` on the run record. Optional `--webhook-url` / `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_URL` fires a best-effort POST `RunCompleteWebhook` after the run reaches `done`|`failed`|`error` (never fails this 202). Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` (HMAC still body-only). Optional `--webhook-secret` / `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_SECRET` signs the POST with `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body). On 5xx or network/timeout, OSS retries the POST once after ~50ms (success on first try = no retry; 4xx do not retry). Simple HMAC is OSS; exponential backoff / queues, key rotation, and timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. Optional body `failUnder` (number): quality gate on pass-rate `score` (passed/total×100, or 0 if total=0). When set, completed JSON includes `score` and `gate: {failUnder, passed}`. `score < failUnder` → status `failed`, `error: below_threshold` (JUnit failures≥1). Omit = no gate (status `done` as today). Queue / rate-limit / watch / ready / junit.xml / tap.txt otherwise unchanged.

get.summary: Get a run by id
get.description: Load run (`status`: `queued` → `running` → `done` | `failed` | `error`; includes pass/fail/`score` when done or failed; `gate` when `failUnder` was set; includes `requestId`). **404** if the run was dropped from finished history (`--runs-max`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

200.description: Run record

get.summary: List cases for one run
get.description: Lightweight case inventory for one run (finished or in-flight). Path `{id}` is the run id (same hex validation as `GET /v1/runs/{id}`). JSON `{ok:true, runId, status, count, cases:[{suite, name, status, durationMs?}]}`. Allowlist only — **never** prompts, expected/actual blobs, output bodies, API keys, Authorization, or webhook URLs. Optional short `error` when already a JUnit/Markdown token (not a secret). Optional `?status=` filter (`passed`/`failed`/`error`/`skipped`); unknown status → empty list **200** (not 400). `count` is the full matching size; array cap **500** in original suite order; `truncated: true` when more. Empty finished run or queued/running with no cases yet → **200** `{ok:true, count:0, cases:[]}`. Unknown id → **404** `{ok:false, error:run_not_found}`. Public like `GET /v1/runs/{id}` (no Bearer unless `--require-key`). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional case-status filter (case-insensitive). Known values: `passed`, `failed`, `error`, `skipped`. Unknown value → empty list **200** (not 400).

200.description: Case inventory (empty arrays when the run has no cases yet)

get.summary: Diff two completed runs by case identity
get.description: Compare this run (`id` = **to**) against another completed run (`against` = **from**) by case identity `suite/name`. Both must be `done`|`failed`|`error`. Default JSON `{ok,from,to,added,removed,regressed,fixed,unchanged}`: `regressed` is pass→fail, `fixed` is fail→pass, `added`/`removed` are cases only in to/from, `unchanged` is a count. Empty both → empty arrays and `unchanged` 0. `?format=md` returns Markdown (`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`) — same body as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.md`. `?format=html` returns self-contained HTML (`text/html; charset=utf-8`) — same body as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.html`. Missing run → **404**. Incomplete → **409** `{error:"run_not_done"}`. Missing `against` → **400**. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. CLI `diff --from a.json --to b.json` prints JSON; `--format md` prints Markdown; `--format html` prints HTML. Distinct from POST `baseline` / `--diff-baseline` (trajectory/score vs a saved snapshot). Does not change fail-under scoring.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: To-run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

parameters.name: against
parameters.description: From-run / last-green id to compare against (must be a completed run)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. Default `json`. `md` returns the same Markdown as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.md` (`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`). `html` returns the same HTML as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.html` (`text/html; charset=utf-8`).

200.description: Case-identity diff (comparison succeeded; inspect `regressed`/`added`/`removed`/`fixed`)

text/html.example:
agent-ci diff

from: 4eb899f51ac0 to: 7809cd71a639

case
demo/flaky

get.summary: Diff two completed runs as Markdown
get.description: Same comparison as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against=` rendered as GitHub-flavored Markdown for `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` / humans. Path `{id}` is **to**; `against` is **from**. Heading + counts + GFM tables for added/removed/regressed/fixed (`|` escaped). Empty diffs → heading + “no changes”. `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`. Same **404** / **409** `{error:"run_not_done"}` / **400** as JSON. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Alias: `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against=&format=md`. CLI `diff --from/--to --format md`. JSON `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff` unchanged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: To-run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

parameters.name: against
parameters.description: From-run / last-green id to compare against (must be a completed run)

200.description: Markdown diff (heading + counts + tables, or heading + “no changes”)

get.summary: Diff two completed runs as HTML
get.description: Same comparison as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against=` rendered as self-contained HTML for the local 5-min demo (open in a browser tab). Path `{id}` is **to**; `against` is **from**. Heading + counts + tables for added/removed/regressed/fixed (names escaped with `html.escape`). Regressed rows are red (inline CSS `class="fail"`). Empty diffs → heading + “no changes”. No CDN. `Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8`. Same **404** / **409** `{error:"run_not_done"}` / **400** as JSON (error bodies stay JSON). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Alias: `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against=&format=html`. CLI `diff --from/--to --format html`. JSON `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff` and Markdown `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.md` unchanged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: To-run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

parameters.name: against
parameters.description: From-run / last-green id to compare against (must be a completed run)

200.description: HTML diff (heading + counts + tables, or heading + “no changes”)

text/html.example:
agent-ci diff

from: 4eb899f51ac0 to: 7809cd71a639

case
demo/flaky

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

200.description: JUnit XML artifact (`{id}.junit.xml`)

get.description: JUnit XML artifact for one completed run (`{id}.junit.xml`). Alias of `GET /v1/runs/{id}/junit.xml`. 404 if missing / not finished. `Content-Type: application/xml`. JSON GET `/v1/runs/{id}` unchanged.

get.summary: Get JUnit XML for a run (.xml)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

200.description: JUnit XML (`<testsuite tests= failures= errors= time=>`; escaped `& < > "`)

get.description: JUnit XML for one completed run. Same body as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/junit`. Built from the run record (`summary.cases` / `status` error). 404 if missing / not finished. `Content-Type: application/xml`.

get.summary: JUnit XML for all completed runs
get.description: JUnit XML for retained completed runs with `status` `done`|`failed`|`error` (same window as GET `/v1/runs`; `--runs-max` / `RUNS_MAX`). Empty → valid `<testsuite tests="0">`. `Content-Type: application/xml`. Does not shadow GET `/v1/runs` or `/v1/runs/{id}`.

200.description: JUnit XML (one suite per completed run; empty → tests="0")

get.summary: Get TAP13 for a run

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

200.description: TAP version 13 (`ok` / `not ok`; `#` diagnostics; empty → `1..0`)

text/plain.example:
TAP version 13
1..2
ok 1 - demo france-capital
not ok 2 - demo math-2plus2

get.description: TAP version 13 for one completed run. Alias of `GET /v1/runs/{id}/tap.txt`. 404 if missing / not finished. `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`. JSON GET `/v1/runs/{id}` and JUnit paths unchanged.

get.summary: Get TAP13 for a run (.txt)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

200.description: TAP version 13 (`TAP version 13` / `1..N` / `ok` / `not ok`; `#` in names escaped)

get.description: TAP version 13 for one completed run. Same body as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/tap`. Built from the run record (`summary.cases` / `status` error / quality gate). Gate fail → a `not ok` line (synthetic `below_threshold` if all cases passed). 404 if missing / not finished. `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`.

get.summary: TAP13 for all completed runs
get.description: TAP version 13 for retained completed runs with `status` `done`|`failed`|`error` (same window as GET `/v1/runs`; `--runs-max` / `RUNS_MAX`). Empty → valid `1..0`. `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`. Does not shadow GET `/v1/runs` or `/v1/runs/{id}`. JUnit `/v1/runs/junit.xml` unchanged.

200.description: TAP version 13 (one stream for completed runs; empty → `1..0`)

For GitHub Actions `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`.

200.description: Redacted runtime config (no secrets)

BearerAuth.description: Paid-seat sketch. `Bearer demo` allowed. No header allowed unless `--require-key`. Any other token → 401.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional correlation id. Echoed on every response as `X-Request-Id`. If omitted/empty, the stub generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped). Also stored as `requestId` on POST `/v1/runs` records, GET `/v1/runs/{id}`, and list rows.

RunId.name: id
RunId.description: Run id (8–64 hex or hyphenated hex)

SuiteName.name: name
SuiteName.description: Fixture suite directory name under fixtures/

XRequestId.description: Echo of incoming `X-Request-Id`, or a generated UUID when the request header is omitted/empty. Present on every response.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on POST /v1/runs **429** queue_full, GET /ready **503** queue_full, and sliding-window **429** `rate_limited`.

AccessControlAllowOrigin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches `--cors-origins` / `AGENT_CI_CORS_ORIGINS` (or `*` when configured). Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

watch.description: Present when `serve --watch` is enabled. Omitted otherwise (stack-demo / default serve).

shuttingDown.description: Present and true while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Omitted otherwise so stack-demo /health is unchanged.

Ready.description: GET /ready body. 200 `{ok:true, queue}` when POST /v1/runs would still enqueue. 503 `{ok:false, reason:"queue_full"}` when at capacity (POST would 429). 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT (wins over healthy 200). `queue` is the same snapshot as GET /health. Does not consume a queue slot.

reason.description: Present on 503: `queue_full` when POST /v1/runs would 429; `shutting_down` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT.

score.description: Pass-rate score 0–100 = passed/total×100 (0 if total=0). Present on completed runs.

CreateRunRequest.description: Provide `suite` (path under bet root, e.g. fixtures/demo) or embedded `cases`.

baseline.description: Baseline path (string) or inline object for diff after the run.

delayMs.description: Local stub aid: sleep before work (capped). Not a product feature.

failUnder.description: Optional quality gate. Pass-rate `score` = passed/total×100 (0 if total=0). When set, completed JSON includes `score` and `gate: {failUnder, passed}`. If `score < failUnder`, status is `failed` with `error: below_threshold` (JUnit failures≥1; synthetic below_threshold case if all cases passed). Omit = no gate (status `done` as today). Typically 0–100; values above 100 fail a perfect suite.

SuiteDetail.description: GET /v1/suites/{name}. Allowlist only — never cassette prompt/trajectory/secrets. `id` equals the directory name. `cases` are `{name}` rows from `*.json` stems.

CorsConfig.description: Optional CORS. Default omitted or empty origins = no extra CORS headers (deny). `origins` may be `["*"]` (any Origin) or an explicit list. When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a non-listed Origin returns 403 `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`; allowed Origin → 204 with ACAO/ACAM/ACAH. Matching GET/POST get Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id`. local-mvp uses `["http://localhost:3000"]`.

origins.description: `["*"]` or explicit origins. Empty/omitted disables CORS.

RunCompleteWebhook.description: Outbound fire-and-forget POST body when a run reaches done|failed|error. Configure `--webhook-url` or `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_URL`. Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` (HMAC still signs the raw body only). Optional `--webhook-secret` / `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_SECRET`: when set, POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw JSON body). Short timeout; errors never fail the run. On 5xx or network/timeout, OSS retries the POST once after ~50ms (success on first try = no retry; 4xx do not retry). Simple HMAC is OSS; exponential backoff / queues, key rotation, and timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. Not an inbound HTTP path.

summary.description: Compact pass/fail counts when available; null on error runs.

conclusion.description: success when done+passed; failure when done and not passed or status=failed (quality gate); error when status=error.

score.description: Pass-rate score when the run produced a summary (omitted on process errors).

gate.description: Present when the run was created with `failUnder`.

WatchSnapshot.description: GET /health `watch` when `--watch` is on. `generation` starts at 0 and increments when `fixtures/` max mtime changes. `GET /v1/suites` still live-reads disk.

generation.description: Increments on each successful fixtures/ mtime change tick.

QualityGate.description: Present on a completed run when POST `failUnder` was set. `passed` is false when `score < failUnder` (status `failed`, `error: below_threshold`).

failUnder.description: Threshold compared to pass-rate score (typically 0–100; values above 100 fail even a perfect suite).

RunDiff.description: GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff?against= and CLI `diff --from/--to` (JSON). Case identity is `suite/name`. `ok` is true when the comparison succeeded (not "no regressions"). `regressed` = pass→fail; `fixed` = fail→pass. Empty both → empty arrays, `unchanged` 0. Markdown: `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.md` / `?format=md` / CLI `--format md`. HTML: `GET /v1/runs/{id}/diff.html` / `?format=html` / CLI `--format html`.

added.description: Cases in to but not from (`suite/name`)

removed.description: Cases in from but not to (`suite/name`)

regressed.description: Cases that were pass in from and fail in to

fixed.description: Cases that were fail in from and pass in to

unchanged.description: Count of cases present in both with the same pass/fail

RuntimeConfig.description: Public redacted runtime config (GET /v1/config). Allowlist only — never webhook URL, webhook secret, Bearer tokens, or fixture file contents. Mirrors B GET /admin/config and F GET /v1/config; C has no admin token on this GET (public like /v1/suites).

queue.description: In-memory run queue cap and cheap current depth.

failUnder.description: Serve-level quality-gate default. Null — C has no server default (per-run POST `failUnder` only).

origins.description: Allowed Origins (`["*"]` = any). Empty = CORS disabled.

webhooks.description: Outbound run-complete webhook presence. Booleans only — never the URL (query tokens) or secret.

hasUrl.description: True when `--webhook-url` / `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_URL` is set. The URL itself is never returned.

hasSecret.description: True when `--webhook-secret` / `AGENT_CI_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is set. The secret itself is never returned.

suitesCount.description: Number of fixture suite dirs (same catalog as GET /v1/suites). Optional.

RunCaseRow.description: Allowlisted case row. Never includes prompt, expected, actual, output, API keys, Authorization, or webhook URLs.

durationMs.description: Present only when already stored on the case record.

error.description: Optional short token already shown in JUnit/Markdown (e.g. `failed`, `below_threshold`). Omitted when missing or secret-like.

RunCases.description: GET /v1/runs/{id}/cases. `count` is the full matching size (not the capped array length). `truncated` is true only when more than 500 cases match.

count.description: Full matching case count (not the capped array length).

truncated.description: True when more than 500 cases match.

NotFound.description: Unknown path, run, suite, JUnit artifact, or diff target

QueueFull.description: In-memory queue is full (running + waiting at capacity). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

RateLimited.description: Sliding-window rate limit exceeded (client IP, X-Forwarded-For first hop). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. `/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics` are not rate-limited. Distinct from POST /v1/runs queue-full 429 `{error:"queue_full"}`.

RunNotDone.description: Run exists but is not completed (`queued` or `running`). Poll GET `/v1/runs/{id}` until `done`|`failed`|`error`. Distinct from **404** missing/dropped.
